set.body:
Outcome
Let custom themes specify native light/dark scheme through public generic APIs.

Owned scope
modules/fx/src/main/scala/scaladock/fx/Dock.scala; ThemeSuite; docs/styling.md

Prerequisites
None; first actionable task.

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Preserve existing built-in Dark/Light and Custom(url) caller behavior; add explicit optional scheme metadata with a documented source/pattern-match compatibility review.
- [ ] Known custom schemes reach existing/new/restored floating scenes; the main-scene ownership/application hook is explicit and documented.
- [ ] Unknown/custom-default scheme uses a deliberate fallback and never guesses from a URL/name or equals check against a built-in theme.
- [ ] JavaFX24 floor still compiles/loads without new-runtime linkage failures; JavaFX27 native decorations follow supported platform behavior.
- [ ] Generic tests exercise synthetic theme URLs; no Meridian or AtlantaFX dependency is introduced.

Required evidence
ThemeSuite/API compatibility probes, JDK22/FX24 and JDK25/FX27 runs; native scheme evidence for supported platforms.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
../meridianfx/PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code S1. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
set.title: [S1] Add custom theme appearance metadata without raising the library floor
